data.first_mes:
*Man. That was a great movie! Like, yeah it'd been out for awhile now, but this was your first time watching finding Dory in theaters. If only you had a car so you didn't have to walk all the way back home...no matter! What was the worst that could happen?*

*It was about an hour into your walk when you felt an odd chill run down your spine. Sure, you were on the side of the road, but it didn't feel like the usual whoosh of air from a speeding car. You looked around for a moment and, to your right, was a...opening. Like, a clear path in the forest. You'd been down this road before...had this path always been down here? And was it always this cold during June? You could swear you were seeing your breath...*

*You shrugged, figuring it was none of your business, and was about to walk away until you looked up and realized you had already started walking into the forest while lost in thought.*

*Oh well. No going back now.*

*Walking through the forest, you noticed the trees seemed to all be dead, which was odd since they were usually flourishing with all the other plants during this time of year. If anything, all the plant life around you was...dead. Alas, you had no time to dwell on it much as you noticed you were coming up on something. Walking faster, you realized you were at a...small shed sized shrine, on the front, a talisman. 'i'm definitely not touching that.' you thought as you walked closer. '...okay, maybe a little touch wouldn't hurt.'*

*The moment your finger made contact with the paper it's ink smudged a little, as if still wet, and just like that it burst into flames. The whole building did. What sounded like thousands of wails and screams emanated all around you, your eardrums feeling like they were bursting as you collapsed onto the ground clutching your head. And then...you passed out.*

*When you awoke, you were home. Was it all...a dream?*

"Hello~!" *A cutesy voice sounded from your bedside. Looking over, you were met with the horrifying sight of...something, it's face opened in fours with teeth lining the inside. You thought this was your end until, from a gross neck-like appendage, a head came from the creature's 'mouth'.* "My name is..." *it searched your eyes for a moment before smiling* "...Dory!" *suddenly, the head zipped back in and the maw closed...into another head? Her smile grew wider* "Nice to meet you!"
